summary.key_theme: 市場高度關注 Broadcom 即將公布的財報表現，同時在 AI 晶片領域的競爭地位與機構投資人的持倉調整之間呈現多空拉鋸。

bullish.title: What's Going On With Broadcom Stock Thursday? — Broadcom (AVGO) stock rises nearly 2% premarket following strong NVIDIA earnings.
bullish.reason: 受惠於 NVIDIA 強勁財報帶動半導體板塊情緒，顯示市場對 AI 基礎設施需求仍具信心，進而推升 Broadcom 股價。

bullish.title: Kyndryl Expands Partnership With Broadcom To Provide Consulting Services For VMware Cloud Foundation
bullish.reason: 與 Kyndryl 擴大合作有助於強化 VMware Cloud Foundation 的市場滲透率，顯示 Broadcom 在軟體與雲端服務領域的持續擴張。

bullish.title: Billionaire David Tepper Sold His Fund's Sandisk Stake in Favor of This Trillion-Dollar Artificial Intelligence (AI) Chip Stock
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 David Tepper 將資金轉向 Broadcom，顯示大型機構對其在 AI 晶片市場長期競爭力的認可。

bullish.title: Daniel Newman Says Broadcom Deserves Credit for OpenAI’s Jalapeño Chip
bullish.reason: 分析師肯定 Broadcom 在 OpenAI 自研晶片中的關鍵技術貢獻，強化其作為 AI 基礎設施核心供應商的地位。

bullish.title: Where Will This Vanguard ETF, Loaded With Nvidia and Broadcom, Be in 10 Years?
bullish.reason: Broadcom 被納入 Vanguard 核心科技 ETF，顯示其作為大型科技股的穩定性與長期投資價值。

bearish.title: Third Point Starts to Raise Alarm Bells on Broadcom After Dumping AVGO Stock in Q2

bearish.title: D.E. Shaw Just Disclosed a $912 Million SpaceX Stake and a 58% Broadcom Cut in the Same Quarter

bearish.title: Broadcom Fell 12.6% on Its Last Beat — Can It Avoid a Repeat in September?

bearish.title: Forget Broadcom: Nvidia (NVDA) Is Still the Top Semiconductor Stock for 2027 and Beyond
bearish.reason: 市場觀點認為 Nvidia 的生態系統優勢大於 Broadcom，可能導致資金排擠效應。
